extraction_notes: This is a very gift-heavy register (Minister for Resources) with ~35 separate alteration notices; pymupdf's text layer was used to verify every page after an initial visual pass, so all notices are typed/processed forms, not handwriting. Key judgement calls: (1) page 15 and page 35 re-declare earlier gift items adding purpose/context or re-attributing the recipient; recorded as change_type='varied', confidence medium, rather than new items. (2) page 18's two gifts were received by staff member Marie Illman (Deputy Chief of Staff), not the Member or spouse; owner='unknown' per convention C8. Page 35 (dated 14/07/2023, processed 17/07/2023) re-declares these same two gifts but reframes them as 'Hon Madeleine King MP was invited...'; recorded as owner='self', change_type='varied'. (3) page 24 re-declares the page-6 Obori Soma Ware teacup gift adding a $100 value (originally 'value unknown'); recorded as change_type='varied'. (4) Liabilities: the creditor cell was changed twice - pages 43-44 (lodged 2023-11-06) add Macquarie Bank and remove Commonwealth Bank/Westpac/St George for both self and spouse, then pages 49-50 (lodged 2023-12-20) add a combined 'Commonwealth Bank, Westpac Bank, St George Bank and Macquarie Bank' and again remove 'Commonwealth Bank, Westpac and St George' for both owners - these two notices appear to largely duplicate each other; both are recorded as printed (one item per bank per owner, C6), confidence medium, since the nature text was not restated verbatim in the addition rows and is inferred from the original liability description. (5) Real estate: pages 49-50 change Beaconsfield from Residential to Investment and add a '15% ownership' qualifier to Osmington (recorded as 'varied'); the Shoalwater Bay WA Residential line re-printed on page 49 has no corresponding deletion and appears to be an unchanged restatement, so no item was recorded for it. Page 61 later changes Shoalwater Bay from Residential to Investment (recorded as 'varied'). (6) page 43's 'Complimentary upgrade to first class on QR900 Doha to Perth' and Qantas Platinum membership, and page 77's two items printed under a combined '11. Gifts / 12. Travel or Hospitality' header, have section numbers that are debatable by content; recorded as printed per convention C3, confidence medium. (7) Several received/date values inside item text are inconsistent with the notice's own signed date (e.g. page 21 'Date: 04/02/2022' vs a Feb-2023 notice; page 16 'Received: 18/11/2022' after a 28/10/2022 signature; page 61 wine gift 'Received: 01/05/2025' inside a May-2024 notice); kept verbatim in description per convention, lodged_date uses the notice's own signed date throughout. (8) page 32's 'Hand fan & stand' gift is dated 'Received: 13/07/2022', well before the notice's June 2023 batch of gifts; kept verbatim as printed.
